title: Quintessential Juicy Ethiopian Lamb Tibs
description: A cultured and juicy Ethiopian dish featuring lamb mince, this recipe is a perfect hangover cure, made with a shio-koji cure and served in a hot pot vessel, friendly to gluten free diets.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together lamb mince, shio-koji, onion, garlic, ginger, berbere spice, salt, and black pepper until just combined.
Heat the vegetable oil in a hot pot vessel over medium high heat.
Add the lamb mixture to the hot pot vessel and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the ethiopian red wine to the hot pot vessel, if using, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the lamb tibs hot, straight from the hot pot vessel.
Traditionally, tibs is served with injera bread, but gluten free alternatives can be used.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
